cited.quote: The Samathuvapuram scheme was discontinued after 2010-11.
the houses are yet to be allotted to the beneficiaries

rationale: C1 and C2 (audit report) concern Samathuvapurams but describe the scheme's discontinuation and idle unallotted houses before 2021; no extract shows a new GO, scheme or measure by this government to regularise Samathuvapurams. Directional commitment with no dedicated measure: not started.

C1 and C3 list highway flood restoration works in other districts, C2 a road widening deposit work, C4 mining, C5 urban employment guidelines. None mentions the Aruvaal Mooku drainage system or Cuddalore drainage.
C1-C3 refer generally to the Dravidian movement's values and legacy; C4 and C5 are unrelated GOs. No extract mentions a memorial (kottam) for Dravidian movement leaders in Chennai.

cited.quote: The scheme to prevent outflow of sewage into waterways in Chennai will be vigorously implemented

rationale: C3 is a budget statement of intent about preventing sewage outflow into Chennai waterways; no GO, tender or launch for cleaning the named rivers/canals. C1 only reallocates business (Buckingham canal maintenance) to a department, not a cleaning step.

cited.quote: Leather Product Park at Panappkkam in Ranipet district and three Food Parks will be established
SIPCOT has envisaged to establish a Leather Product Park at the proposed SIPCOT Industrial Park, Panappakam, Ranipet

rationale: C1 (budget) and C2 (policy note) only plan a leather product park in Ranipet district, not in Dindigul, Vellore or Chennai, and neither is an official step such as a GO. Not started.

cited.quote: Hence, a separate Ministry for Water Resources has been established.
this Government, after taking charge, has instituted a separate Department called “Water Resources Department”

rationale: C1 (Governor's address, June 2021) reports that a separate Ministry for Water Resources has been established; C3 confirms a separate Water Resources Department was instituted after the government took charge. Exact date not given; year 2021 from C1.
C1-C5 are police notes ordering transfers and postings of officers. None mentions constituting a Police Commission or implementing its recommendations.

cited.quote: has announced various welfare measures for the children who had lost both the parent

rationale: C1/C2 is a GO for children orphaned by Covid-19, a narrower, different scheme; C4 lists general social welfare allocations. No extract shows a special Women and Child Welfare Scheme under the Chief Minister's direct supervision.

cited.quote: To enable this, if necessary Article 343 of the Constitution should be suitably amended.

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states the government will continue to urge the Union and that Article 343 should be amended if necessary; this is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution or Chief Minister's letter. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: High performance coaching, cash incentives, travel expenses for participation in competitions would be provided for

rationale: C2 and C3 mention sports coaching and sports budget allocations in general; no extract mentions a Games Village in Chennai or any official step toward one.

cited.quote: native Tamils, especially those that have studied in Tamil-medium and Government schools, are given priority in recruitment for Government posts.

rationale: C2 (Governor's address) states an intent to give native Tamils priority in recruitment, not 100% allocation, and reports no GO. C1, C3-C5 concern unrelated employment schemes. Not started.

cited.quote: The monthly miscellaneous expenditure allowance for hostel students will be doubled to Rs.100 for school students

rationale: C1 (budget speech) announces doubling a miscellaneous allowance for hostel students, not a periodic inflation-linked revision of food allowance, and it is only an announcement. C2-C4 are minimum wage notifications for workers. Not started.

cited.quote: Billing efficiency will be improved and energy conservation promoted.

rationale: C3 mentions improving billing efficiency in a budget speech but nothing on switching from bimonthly to monthly electricity billing; other extracts are minimum wage notifications and fiscal matters. No official step.

cited.quote: During the financial year 2020-21, 646.981 lakh units of power have been exported by these 5 Mills to

rationale: C1 describes existing co-generation plants in sugar mills exporting power to the grid during 2020-21, i.e. continuing activity before this government; no new action plan or GO for TANGEDCO purchasing power from sugar factories. Directional: not started.

cited.quote: will also be restructured and the scholarship enhanced to Rupees one lakh per annum to benefit more students.

rationale: C4 is a budget speech announcing enhanced Ph.D scholarships and study-abroad provisions for SC/ST students; this is a statement of intent, not a GO. C1 is a portal maintenance reimbursement, C2 an audit of past payments. No operational increase shown.

cited.quote: the comprehensive range of health care services to be delivered right at the doorstep of households in the community

rationale: C1 is the GO for a doorstep health scheme focused on non-communicable diseases, palliative care and physiotherapy; it only refers pregnant women for antenatal care and does not provide check-ups, medicines and vaccinations to pregnant women by doctors in a mobile hospital. Related scheme only.

cited.quote: 17,980 MW of power generation capacity will be added through own generating stations

rationale: C2 speaks generally of adding generation capacity; no extract names the Udangudi or Cheyyur projects or shows any official step on them. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: creation of barrier free environment in the following fourteen State Government buildings at Chennai city

rationale: C1 sanctions barrier-free works in fourteen government buildings and C5 mandates equal opportunity policies; neither makes solar panels, ramps or rainwater harvesting mandatory for multi-storeyed buildings. C2 concerns farm solar pumps and ponds. Not started.

cited.quote: Where Government desires free or subsidized ridership, or operation of uneconomical routes explicit subsidy will be paid

rationale: C1 discusses subsidised ridership for transport corporations generally and metro construction, but nothing on subsidised metro fares for students. C2 and C5 are MRTS study GOs; C3/C4 list school welfare items. No official step.
C1-C3 and C5 concern solar pumpsets for farmers under PM-KUSUM; C4 lists TIIC loan schemes. None mentions procurement of energy (net) meter devices.
